description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. H. P. S. Dharmasiri as Chief Accountant of the Presidents Fund, w.e.f. 02.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. H. P. S.
